resources.string: Persistent foreground notification keeping Dynamic Island running
Dynamic Island needs "Display over other apps" permission to render the floating pill above your screen and status bar.
To display real-time music metadata (song title, artist) and playback controls from Spotify, YouTube Music, etc., Android requires Notification Access to connect to Media Sessions.
Required on Android 13+ to keep the persistent foreground service alive without being terminated.
CMF Phone 2 Pro / Nothing OS Optimization

Nothing OS has aggressive battery saver rules that may sleep background services. To ensure 24/7 reliability:

1. Long press Dynamic Island icon > App Info (or Settings > Apps > Dynamic Island)
2. Tap "App battery usage" (or Battery)
3. Set to "Unrestricted"
4. In Nothing OS Recents, tap the app icon and tap "Lock" to prevent clearing.
